text:
alex: Perf run #4 on 8xA100, NVLink+EFA mixed cluster. Enabling KV-shard + pipeline parallel gives a 2.2x tail latency spike at p99. Attached perf summary from perf-bot. Anyone seen this pattern before?

perf-bot: automated profile uploaded: s3://perf-artifacts/1793456789/kvshard-run4.tar.gz (flamegraph + nccl traces) :robot_face:

maria: saw something similar last month when KV shards were interleaved across nodes. lots of small cross-node fetches.

raj: can you paste the batcher config? smaller micro-batches can explode all-reduce frequency with TP.

alex: batcher: {"max_tokens": 2048, "max_batch_size": 16, "pad_to_multiple": 8, "micro_batch_size": 8} (we do dynamic packing). KV shard layout: round-robin across ranks.

jen: round-robin KV across nodes is the likely culprit. if ranks serving the same sequence need the prefix KVs, you get synchronous cross-node pulls right in the hot loop.

sam: also check kernel selection: we fell back to the non-fused attention kernel for seq_len>1536 in this run (we've been toggling the fused kernel threshold). that increases compute per-token and widens the comm/compute gap.

lee: NVLink intra-node is fine but EFA cross-node bandwidth+latency kills small-message all-reduces. The trace shows many 8–32KB messages for KV exchanges and frequent NCCL kicks.

maria: two quick experiments: 1) colocate KV shards with tensor-parallel ranks for the same pipeline stage, 2) increase fused-kernel threshold so compute per-step increases and amortizes comm. both reduced p99 last time. :thumbsup:

alex: tried colocate in run#5 (separate job) — p99 dropped ~30% but throughput fell 8% because some nodes got hot. need smarter placement.

raj: what about switching to aggregated prefetching? instead of per-step fetch, prefetch the whole prefix KV for active sessions into local cache when a new conversation is pinned to a rank. trades memory for fewer cross-node RPCs.

jen: agree. also add a heuristic in the router: if predicted prefix hit rate>60% route to same node variant. else fallback to distributed KV. we have telemetry to estimate that.

sam: another lever: collapse micro-batches into larger fused forward calls to reduce NCCL flushes. but watch OOM. also consider NCCL environment tweaks: NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME and NCCL_P2P_LEVEL to favor NVLink where available.

lee: for EFA-heavy clusters, enable message coalescing window of ~200us in our comm layer; it reduced small-message overhead in the traces by ~40% in our test harness.

perf-bot: regression alert: kernel_selection_v2 enabled correlated with 12% increase in p50 compute time for layer_norm for sequences >1536 (see /profiles/ks_v2_1793456789.json).

alex: action items: 1) run kv-colocate + prefetch prototype on staging (maria+raj), 2) try kernel_selection_v1 fallback for long seqs (sam), 3) tune NCCL/comm coalescing on EFA nodes (lee), 4) add routing heuristic to router service (jen). I'll open PRs and schedule a perf run.

maria: adding a small note — when colocating KV we must avoid single-node hot-shard; consider shard-replication factor=2 and sticky routing.

raj: will set up a 4-node repro with mixed fabric (intra-node NVLink, cross-node EFA) and run a sweep over micro-batch sizes and prefetch window. expecting to share results by EOD tomorrow.

jen: ping me when repo is up, will wire router heuristic test.

alex: thanks everyone. leaving the perf artifacts link in thread again: s3://perf-artifacts/1793456789/kvshard-run4.tar.gz.

sam: :eyes: will try kernel fallback and post perf diff.

lee: I'll test NCCL coalescing knobs on the infra side, cc eng-infra for infra-level changes.

perf-bot: reminder: if you change any kernel heuristics, run the eval-suite with our standard prompt-set to catch quality regressions. :white_check_mark:
